seo.description: Villeroy & Boch sanitaryware, baths and ViClean shower toilet seats, fitted correctly on Stoke Poges' large plots. Fit-only from £3,500, £125 survey first.

h1: Villeroy & Boch bathroom installation in Stoke Poges

hero.intro: A village of large plots and substantial houses built up around the identity of Stoke Park's golf and country club, Stoke Poges gives us more room to work with on most bathroom layouts than a smaller property allows — and that extra room is often exactly where a second en-suite or a reconfigured principal bathroom gets added using a Villeroy & Boch ViClean shower toilet seat. We fit Villeroy & Boch sanitaryware, basins, baths and ViClean products sourced through showrooms and retailers, working fit-only from £3,500: you supply the products, we handle the strip-out, first fix, plumbing, tiling and snagging.

sections.heading: ViClean shower toilet seats: what the installation actually involves
sections.body: A ViClean shower toilet seat adds integrated washing and drying functions to a Villeroy & Boch pan, which means the installation needs a nearby water supply and, usually, a power supply run to the unit — neither of which a standard WC installation requires. We plan both of these at survey stage, before the wall is closed up, because retrofitting a power supply after tiling is finished is a far bigger job than running it during the first fix. In the larger Stoke Poges properties we work in, there's often more flexibility to route a supply discreetly than in a smaller bathroom, but it still has to be planned rather than assumed.

sections.heading: Sanitaryware and basins: the glaze and the frame
sections.body: Villeroy & Boch's ceramics are precise and the glaze finishes hold up well over years of use, which is a large part of why the brand keeps appearing across the bathrooms we fit in Stoke Poges' larger properties. The detail that catches people out isn't the ceramic itself, though — it's that Villeroy & Boch doesn't manufacture its own carrier frame, so the flush plate, pan and concealed cistern frame need confirming as compatible generations before any of it is ordered. We check this against the specification at survey, so it's settled before fitting day rather than discovered once the wall is boarded.

sections.heading: Large plots, more layout freedom
sections.body: Stoke Poges' housing ranges from older period detached homes to more recent executive-style builds, many set well back from the road on sizeable gardens, and that scale generally gives us far more room to manoeuvre on layout than a smaller property would allow — relocating a waste run, widening a doorway for level access, or adding a second en-suite off a principal bedroom rarely runs into the structural constraints a terraced house would present. That flexibility is useful when positioning a Villeroy & Boch suite, but we still confirm what applies to your specific house at the £125 survey rather than assuming it from the plot size alone.

faqs.q: Does a ViClean shower toilet seat need anything extra fitting behind it?
faqs.a: Yes — a nearby water supply and usually a power supply, both of which we plan and run during first fix, before the wall is closed up and tiled.

faqs.q: Do you supply Villeroy & Boch products for Stoke Poges installations?
faqs.a: No, we're fit-only. You source the sanitaryware, basins, baths or ViClean products through a showroom or retailer, and we handle the installation from £3,500.

faqs.q: Why does the carrier frame matter for a Villeroy & Boch WC?
faqs.a: Villeroy & Boch doesn't make its own carrier frame, so the pan, flush plate and concealed cistern frame need to be confirmed as matching generations before ordering — we check this at survey, not on fitting day.

faqs.q: Can Stoke Poges' larger plots make a second en-suite easier to add?
faqs.a: Often, yes — the larger, more set-back properties here tend to give more flexibility for relocating waste runs and adding a second en-suite than a terraced house would allow. We confirm what's achievable for your specific house at the £125 survey.
